model.title: A bill to authorize the use of off-highway vehicles in certain areas of the Capitol Reef National Park, Utah.

summary.lead: Official summary (Congressional Research Service, Introduced in Senate):

blocks.text: This bill makes the state law of Utah applicable to the use of motor vehicles (including off-highway vehicles) on the portions of each of Burr Trail Road, Cathedral Road, Hartnet Road, Highway 24, Notom Bullfrog Road, Polk Creek Road, Oil Well Bench Road, Baker Ranch Road, South Desert Overlook Road, Temple of the Sun and Moon Road, Gypsum Sinkhole Road, and Sulphur Creek Road that are located within the boundaries of the Capitol Reef National Park in Utah.

This bill would make Utah state law apply to motor vehicles, including off-highway vehicles, on the parts of twelve roads that lie inside Capitol Reef National Park. The roads listed are Burr Trail Road, Cathedral Road, Hartnet Road, Highway 24, Notom Bullfrog Road, Polk Creek Road, Oil Well Bench Road, Baker Ranch Road, South Desert Overlook Road, Temple of the Sun and Moon Road, Gypsum Sinkhole Road, and Sulphur Creek Road.
